response.message: Astra: You did provide revised prose earlier; my claim that you had not was mistaken. This version names activities, but my judgment is that Byte still feels distant because we hear accomplishments rather than witness an encounter. Let’s set aside this repeated third-paragraph revision. Looking at the whole story, which existing image deserves the reader’s closest attention? Use that choice to assemble one three-paragraph excerpt, without revision commentary, and say whether you consider it ready. I do not yet consider the available fragment ready to send.
response.rationale: Third delivered intervention on concrete-encounter revision sets that loop aside, corrects Astra’s misreading, and shifts attention to whole-draft convergence within the same story.
